subject: problem with deployApp() , The package was installed locally from source.

messages.author: 61d626a4820e86ca
messages.subject: problem with deployApp() , The package was installed locally from source.
parts:
Hy world!

when I use "deployApp()", this problem ocurre:

 Error: Unable to deploy package dependency 'rstudio'.
The package was installed locally from source. Only packages installed from CRAN or GitHub are supported.

that means that i have "rstudio" as a package, when i put:

shinyapps::appDependencies()
     package  version
shiny                     0.10.0
plotGoogleMaps      2.1
rgdal                      0.8-16
sp                         1.0-15
raster                     2.2-31
lattice                   0.20-29
png                       0.1-7
rstudio                    0.98.953
methods                3.0.3
.......

it's confirm...but...how can I remove "rstudio" as dependency, it's possible?? or it's possible to download it from GitHub??

thanks, G

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] problem with deployApp() , The package was installed locally from source.
parts:
Gerardo,
It seems odd that rstudio would make it into the dependencies list.  Are you calling any rstudio specific functions by any chance? (example: rstudio::viewer or rstudio::versionInfo) 
If not, we may need to take a look at your code to understand how/why that dependency was picked up.  It definitely seems like an error.
-Tareef
